basic_details.job_title: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3047 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)
basic_details.short_information: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has released the ONGC Recruitment 2026 notification for 3047 Apprentice vacancies across various work centres in India. Eligible candidates with 10th, 12th, ITI, Diploma, B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, or Engineering qualifications can apply for the respective apprentice trades. The online application process started on 29 October 2026, and the last date to apply is 20 November 2026. Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300, depending on their qualifications.

age_limit.details: The minimum age for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum age is 24 years as on 29 November 2026. | The notification specifies the general eligible date-of-birth range as 29 November 2002 to 29 November 2008.

qualification.details: ONGC has invited applications from candidates holding the qualifications prescribed for the respective apprenticeship trades. Candidates should carefully check the educational requirements before submitting the application form. | Important Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification from a recognized institution. Applicants should not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently pursuing apprenticeship training are not eligible under the notification's conditions. Additional restrictions apply to Technician Apprentices with one year or more of relevant post-qualification training or work experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates interested in applying for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 can follow the instructions below.
Visit the official ONGC website at ongcindia.com.
Read the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification and check the complete eligibility conditions.
Select an eligible work centre and apprenticeship trade according to the qualification and location rules.
Check whether the selected trade comes under the NAPS or NATS scheme.
Visit the NAPS portal or NATS portal, as applicable.
Register or log in to the respective apprenticeship portal.
Complete the required personal, educational, and registration details.
Find the appropriate ONGC apprenticeship opportunity and select the correct work centre and trade.
Provide the documents and other information requested by the portal.
Verify all details carefully and submit the application before 20 November 2026.
Save the submitted application details for future reference.

Important: ONGC accepts applications online only. Applications submitted by post, by hand, or through other offline modes will not be accepted. Applicants are instructed to apply for one trade at one work centre.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The ONGC Apprentice online application process started on 29 October 2026. Candidates must complete the application before the last date to avoid missing this apprenticeship opportunity. Note: ONGC reserves the right to extend the application deadline if sufficient applications or suitable candidates are not available. Candidates should check the official website for any updates.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Sector-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification advertises a total of 3047 vacancies across different sectors and work centres. The sector-wise vacancy details published in the notification are given below. Important: The sector-wise totals printed in the official notification add up to 3049, while ONGC has mentioned 3047 as the grand total. Candidates should follow the official advertised total and check for any clarification or corrigendum issued by ONGC. Candidates searching for ONGC Recruitment 2026 Tripura can apply for eligible apprenticeship opportunities at the ONGC Agartala work centre. The official notification lists 200 vacancies in Agartala for various trades, including Electrician, Fitter, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA), Mechanic Diesel, Welder, Surveyor, Fire Safety Technician, and selected engineering disciplines. According to Annexure I of the notification, candidates domiciled in or holding the required qualification from the eligible districts of Tripura may apply for the Agartala work centre, subject to other recruitment conditions. Under ONGC Recruitment 2026 Assam , apprenticeship vacancies are available at Jorhat, Nazira and Sivasagar, and Silchar. The Eastern Sector includes the following work-centre vacancies. Candidates from the eligible districts of Assam can check the trade-wise vacancies, required qualifications, and apprenticeship scheme before applying online. The ONGC Dehradun work centre has 138 apprentice vacancies . Available trades and disciplines include COPA, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Fitter, Lab Chemist/Analyst, Secretarial Office Assistant, Accounts Executive, Civil Executive, and Petroleum Executive. Candidates must meet the required qualifications and location eligibility conditions. The official ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification does not list a separate Odisha work centre. However, candidates from eligible districts of Odisha may be considered for the Kolkata work centre, which has 34 apprenticeship vacancies , subject to the qualification and domicile conditions specified in Annexure I.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Eligibility and Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has invited applications from candidates holding the qualifications prescribed for the respective apprenticeship trades. Candidates should carefully check the educational requirements before submitting the application form. Important Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification from a recognized institution. Applicants should not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently pursuing apprenticeship training are not eligible under the notification's conditions. Additional restrictions apply to Technician Apprentices with one year or more of relevant post-qualification training or work experience.

rows.qualification: Relevant ITI qualification or applicable 12th / two-year ITI qualification as prescribed
Three-Year Diploma in Relevant Engineering Discipline
Graduate with Geology as one of the subjects

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 years , and the maximum age is 24 years as on 29 November 2026. The notification specifies the general eligible date-of-birth range as 29 November 2002 to 29 November 2008.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Salary 2026 - Monthly Stipend
content_sections.text: The ONGC Apprentice salary per month ranges from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on the apprentice category and educational qualification. These amounts are monthly training stipends rather than permanent employee salaries. Note: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months. ONGC will not reimburse transportation, boarding, or lodging expenses during training. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment in ONGC.

rows.qualification: BA / B.Com / B.Sc / BBA / BE / B.Tech

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is based on the marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for these apprenticeship opportunities. Applications will be received through the NAPS and NATS portals. ONGC will verify the eligibility and qualifications of applicants. A provisional merit list will be prepared based on qualifying examination marks. Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. The final merit list will be prepared after verification and application of the relevant reservation rules. Selected candidates must complete the required apprenticeship engagement formalities. In case of a tie in qualifying examination marks, preference will be given to the older candidate. The scheduled result / selection date is 15 December 2026 , subject to official updates.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 online application through the appropriate government apprenticeship portal. Candidates applying for NAPS trades must use the NAPS portal, while candidates applying for NATS trades must use the NATS portal. Candidates should ensure that they have applied to the correct ONGC apprenticeship opportunity. Registration on NAPS or NATS alone does not necessarily mean that the application for the selected ONGC trade has been submitted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ONGC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in applying for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 can follow the instructions below. Visit the official ONGC website at ongcindia.com . Read the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification and check the complete eligibility conditions. Select an eligible work centre and apprenticeship trade according to the qualification and location rules. Check whether the selected trade comes under the NAPS or NATS scheme. Visit the NAPS portal or NATS portal , as applicable. Register or log in to the respective apprenticeship portal. Complete the required personal, educational, and registration details. Find the appropriate ONGC apprenticeship opportunity and select the correct work centre and trade. Provide the documents and other information requested by the portal. Verify all details carefully and submit the application before 20 November 2026. Save the submitted application details for future reference. Important: ONGC accepts applications online only. Applications submitted by post, by hand, or through other offline modes will not be accepted. Applicants are instructed to apply for one trade at one work centre.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted for document verification may be required to produce the following original documents along with self-attested copies: 10th Class Certificate or Date of Birth Proof Educational Qualification Mark Sheets ITI / Diploma / Degree Certificate, as applicable Category Certificate, if applicable PwBD Certificate, if applicable Valid Identity Proof NAPS / NATS Registration Details Required Work Centre Eligibility Documents Any Additional Documents Specified by ONGC

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to download and read the official ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 PDF before applying online. Official Notification: ONGC Recruitment Notices

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ONGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC has advertised 3047 Apprentice vacancies under Advertisement No. ONGC/APPR/1/2026. The notification's sector-wise subtotals contain a discrepancy, so candidates should check for any official clarification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official NAPS portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in or the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in, depending on the selected apprentice trade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the ONGC Apprentice salary per month in 2026?
faq.answer: The ONGC Apprentice monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300, depending on the apprentice category and qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Can ITI candidates apply for ONGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. ITI-qualified candidates can apply for eligible apprenticeship trades such as Electrician, Fitter, COPA, Welder, Mechanic Diesel, and other notified trades, subject to the required qualification and work-centre eligibility.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026. Upper age relaxation is applicable for eligible reserved categories according to the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available under ONGC Recruitment 2026 Tripura?
faq.answer: The ONGC Agartala work centre in Tripura has 200 Apprentice vacancies for various trades and disciplines.

faq.question: Q8. How many ONGC Apprentice vacancies are available in Assam?
faq.answer: The notification lists 674 vacancies across Jorhat, Nazira and Sivasagar, and Silchar work centres in Assam.

faq.question: Q9. Can Odisha candidates apply for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates from eligible districts of Odisha may apply for the Kolkata work-centre opportunities, subject to the prescribed qualification and location eligibility conditions. No separate Odisha work centre is listed.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a written examination for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No separate written examination is prescribed in the notification. Selection is based on qualifying examination marks, eligibility verification, and document verification.
